name: Bible Plugin
description: OpenClaw-native /bible slash command for devotional and study summaries.

provider.description: Model provider. OpenRouter uses the configured API key; Ollama does not send authorization.

model.description: Model ID passed directly to the configured endpoint; OpenClaw aliases are not resolved.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort sent to direct Ollama requests. Use none to disable thinking overhead.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum model request duration in milliseconds.

signalMaxChars.description: Maximum character count for short mode replies.

defaultMode.description: Fallback response mode when no valid mode token is provided in command args.

openrouterApiKey.description: Direct OpenRouter API key; falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY and is ignored for Ollama.
